# AI Governance Checklist: AI Test Design Assistance

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for AI-assisted generation, credit lifecycle, security, API contracts, and Workspace UX before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-05-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are credit lifecycle requirements complete for estimate, reserve, capture, release, refund/adjustment, and insufficient-credit cases? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Research Summary]
- [ ] CHK002 Are AI run lifecycle requirements complete for estimated, reserved, running, completed, failed, and cancelled states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Data Model §AiRun]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for both supported generation types: scenarios from business rules and test cases from scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001-FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are artifact persistence requirements complete for all generated fields needed by draft test scenarios and draft test cases? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model §TestScenario, Data Model §TestCase]
- [ ] CHK005 Are audit requirements complete for estimate, start, success, failure, credit movement, and AI draft artifact creation events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Data Model §AuditLog]
- [ ] CHK006 Are documentation requirements complete for local mock usage and optional real-provider environment variables? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Quickstart §Environment]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "credit estimate before generation" specified clearly enough to define when confirmation becomes stale or invalid? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "failed platform-side AI run" distinguished from validation, permission, insufficient-credit, provider, platform, and output-validation failures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §AiRun]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "structured QA artifact" defined with required minimum fields for generated scenarios and test cases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §TestScenario, Data Model §TestCase]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "draft/AI-assisted" defined consistently as status plus AI marker rather than a visual-only label? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK011 Are permission and entitlement requirements clear about which identifiers must be validated for every estimate, generation, save, and run lookup? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the boundary between mock provider, configured real provider, and frontend mock behavior unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011-FR-013, Plan §Technical Context]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are endpoint paths and operation names consistent between the plan, API contract, and existing API design document expectations? [Consistency, Contract §paths, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK014 Are credit lifecycle terms consistent across spec, research, data model, and contract error responses? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008-FR-009, Research §Credit Lifecycle, Contract §402/502]
- [ ] CHK015 Are AI run status values consistent across requirements, data model, and run status contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Data Model §AiRun, Contract §AiRunStatus]
- [ ] CHK016 Are artifact source relationships consistent across BusinessRule, TestScenario, TestCase, and AiRun references? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Relationships]
- [ ] CHK017 Are MVP out-of-scope boundaries consistent across spec and plan: no Check-up, no streaming, no billing purchase, no workers, no invasive scanning? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constraints]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Are success criteria measurable without relying on implementation-specific details? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the 2-minute user outcome specify which parts of the flow are included and whether real-provider latency is excluded or included? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the "0 secrets exposed" criterion broad enough to include frontend env vars, browser payloads, logs, docs examples, and test fixtures? [Coverage, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the "90% of users avaliadores" criterion defined with enough context to know audience, sample, or review method? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK022 Are validation criteria defined for preserving existing deterministic Workspace flows while adding AI assistance? [Completeness, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are primary flow requirements complete for estimate, confirmation, generation, persistence, and display of generated scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK024 Are primary flow requirements complete for estimate, confirmation, generation, persistence, and display of generated test cases? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK025 Are exception flow requirements defined for missing source artifact, permission denial, insufficient credits, provider failure, malformed output, and stale estimate? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are recovery flow requirements defined for reconnecting or reloading the frontend after a generation request has already started? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Are duplicate-run prevention requirements defined with enough clarity to know whether duplicates are blocked, warned, deduplicated, or allowed? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for provider output that is valid JSON but semantically weak, duplicate, unsafe, or not useful as QA artifacts? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for partial success where some generated artifacts are valid and others fail validation? [Gap, Data Model §AiRun]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for credit release behavior when artifact persistence fails after provider output succeeds? [Gap, Spec §FR-008-FR-009]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for organizations exceeding AI usage limits separately from having insufficient credits? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for maximum input size, generated artifact count, and context minimization? [Completeness, Contract §Schemas, Plan §Scale/Scope]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK033 Are performance expectations specified separately for mock/local generation and configured real-provider generation? [Clarity, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK034 Are reliability requirements specified for preserving run and credit traceability across provider timeouts and backend errors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007-FR-009]
- [ ] CHK035 Are observability requirements specified beyond audit logs, such as safe operational signals for failed provider calls and credit adjustments? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK036 Are security requirements complete for protecting provider secrets, minimizing sensitive input, and preventing raw provider payload exposure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Sensitive data handling]
- [ ] CHK037 Are localization requirements clear that new user-facing UI copy is pt-BR only and no new en/es dictionaries are added during MVP? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-025]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK038 Are assumptions about existing auth/demo user foundation explicit enough to guide backend permission tests without triggering a production auth rewrite? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Minimal permission foundation]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the Java version discrepancy documented as a requirement-quality risk that must be resolved before implementation tasks are generated? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK040 Are dependencies on existing Workspace artifact models and UI persistence clearly documented for safe test case generation? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK041 Are documentation update requirements specific enough to identify README, API design, data model, roadmap, or current status touchpoints? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Project Structure]
